question: Edward earned 8 dollars for every lawn he mowed. If he mowed 5 lawns and he already had 7 dollars saved up, how much money does he have total?
Olivia had 7 math problems to complete. She spent about 4 minutes on each problem and then she spent 3 minutes checking her answers. How many minutes did she spend total?
A lawn care company bought 4 lawnmower blade for $8 each. They also bought a spool of weed eater string for $7. How much money did they spend on supplies?
While playing a game Frank defeated 6 enemies. Each enemy earned him 9 points. Then he got another 8 points for completing the level. How many points did he earn total?

A baker made 2 batches of chocolate chip cookies. Each batch had 3 cookies in it. Then he made an additional 4 oatmeal cookies just in case someone didn't want chocolate chip. How many cookies did he bake total?
A music teacher had 2 recorders, but she decided to buy 9 more boxes with each box having 3 recorders in it. How many recorders did she have after buying the 9 boxes?
A florist needed to use 2 pounds of fertilizer for 9 days and then on the final day use the normal amount plus another 4 pounds. How many pounds of fertilizer will she use all together?
A clothing company used 2 buttons on jeans and 5 buttons on shirts. If they made 9 shirts and 1 pair of jeans, how many buttons would they use total?
Amy worked as a sacker at the grocery store where she made $2/hr. If she worked for 7 hours and also made $9 in tips, how much money did she earn?

Zoe bought an app that cost $5 dollars. Then each month you have to pay $8 to play online. If she played the game online for 2 months, how much money would she have spent total for the app and the online access?
A company was offering a special on cell phones for $2 each. But only if you spent 7 dollars a month for 4 months. How much would it end up costing you total if you bought 1 phone?
At the arcade Amy had 6 tickets she saved from the last time she went. This time she played a game 7 times and earned 5 tickets each time she played. How many tickets does she have now?
A malt shop used 4 ounces of chocolate syrup in their shakes and 6 ounces of syrup on their cones. If they sold 2 shakes and 1 cone, how many ounces of chocolate would they use total?
While playing a game Sam had ninety-two points. If he scored another three points, how many points would he have total?
In the first half of a trivia game Kaleb scored forty-three points. In the second half he scored twenty-three points. How many points did he score total?
For a party Henry spent forty-five dollars on food and thirty-three dollars on drinks. How much did Henry spend total?
There were sixty-one people in line at lunch when twenty-two more got in line. How many people were there total in line?
An aquarium had ten fish in it. Later they added three fish. How many fish are in the aquarium now?
Maria had fifty sheets of paper in her desk and forty-one more in her backpack. How many did she have total?
On Facebook Debby had sixty-three photos of her friends and twenty-three photos of her family. How many photos did she have total?
Adam had seventy-nine dollars saved up. After doing some chores his mother gave him another thirteen dollars. How much money does he have total?
Debby received twenty-one text messages before noon and another eighteen after noon. How many text messages did Debby receive total?
At the fair Amy started with thirty-three tickets and then bought twenty-one more. How many tickets did Amy have total?
Mike collected seventy-one cans to recycle on Monday and twenty-seven more on Tuesday. How many cans did Mike collect all together?
A baker already had seventy-eight cakes but made nine extra. How many cakes did the baker have total?
